turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. You asked about the two bedroom flat on Elm Road. When are you hoping to move?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ideally the start of next month. My lease ends on the thirtieth.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That lines up well, the flat is available from the first. Who would be living there with you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. The rent is fourteen hundred a month. Does that sit within your budget?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like to see it? We have Saturday viewings between ten and two.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Saturday at eleven would be perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done, you're booked for Saturday at eleven at Elm Road. A member of our team will meet you there, and I'll text you the address and their name now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. See you Saturday, bye for now.
